children: Hyper Bit Technologies plans a non-brokered private placement of up to 5M units at $0.105 each, for gross proceeds of up to $525K. Proceeds are intended for crypto mining rigs, marketing and working capital.
Offering targets up to $525K gross proceeds
The placement would raise capital but may dilute existing shareholders; the release does not state the expected dilution percentage.
Each unit includes one common share and one warrant, adding potential future share dilution.
Each warrant buys one share at $0.15
Warrants are exercisable for 36 months, subject to acceleration; exercise could provide additional capital and increase share count.
Proceeds planned for mining rigs, marketing and working capital
The stated use directs proceeds toward operations, but no equipment quantity or expected business impact is provided.

This is a financing announcement for a crypto-mining company, rather than confirmation of operating or financial results. Completion of the offering and deployment of proceeds into mining rigs would be needed to establish the resulting operational impact.
